title: Recording: Have You Seen A Horizon Lately?, Shiranakatta (I Didn’t Know) by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were recorded on 6 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘Have You Seen A Horizon Lately?’ was first recorded on 2 November, but was re-recorded during this session. It was mixed on 19 November.

‘Shiranakatta (I Didn’t Know)’ was a new song, and was completed on this day. It too was mixed on the 19th, and again on 22 November.
